title: Artistic Representations of Guide Dogs from Medieval Manuscripts
descriptions: This is the archived data that was collected for my NWO XS project on medieval guide dogs. The data provided the basis for some of the analysis in my forthcoming book, Textual and Artistic Representations of Guide Dogs in Northwestern Europe, 1100 to 1500. London: Palgrave [accepted and under contract; forthcoming 2025].
